name: Grow Notic
nav_html:
<style>
/* Grow Notic — "Orbit": an open ring and a rising arrow, dark and light bands, tokens only */
.gn-w{max-width:var(--w,1300px);margin:0 auto;padding:0 clamp(20px,4vw,48px)}
.gn-s{padding:var(--pad) 0;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.gn-s.sm{padding:calc(var(--pad)*.55) 0}
.gn-d{background:var(--c-primary);color:var(--on-primary)}
.gn-l{background:var(--c-surface);color:var(--c-text)}
.gn-t{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c-primary) 5%,var(--c-surface));color:var(--c-text)}
.gn-d h1,.gn-d h2,.gn-d h3,.gn-d h4{color:var(--on-primary)}
.gn-k{display:block;font:600 12px/1 var(--f-head);letter-spacing:.32em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c-secondary);margin-bottom:22px}
.gn-d .gn-k{color:var(--c-accent)}
.gn-h{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:var(--hw);letter-spacing:var(--hls);line-height:var(--hlh);color:inherit}
h1.gn-h{font-size:clamp(38px,7vw,var(--h1))}
h2.gn-h{font-size:clamp(30px,4.4vw,var(--h2))}
.gn-h em{font-style:normal;color:var(--c-secondary)}
.gn-d .gn-h em{color:var(--c-accent)}
.gn-lead{font-size:clamp(17px,1.7vw,20px);line-height:1.65;max-width:56ch;opacity:.86;margin-top:22px}
.gn-b{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:52px;padding:0 28px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--c-accent);color:var(--c-primary);border:2px solid var(--c-accent);font:700 14px var(--f-head);letter-spacing:.04em;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background .25s,color .25s,border-color .25s}
.gn-b i{font-style:normal;display:inline-block;transition:transform .25s}
.gn-b:hover i{transform:translate(4px,-4px)}
.gn-b:hover{background:var(--c-primary);color:var(--c-accent)}
.gn-d .gn-b:hover{background:transparent;color:var(--c-accent)}
.gn-b.o{background:transparent;color:inherit;border-color:currentColor}
.gn-b.o:hover{background:var(--c-accent);color:var(--c-primary);border-color:var(--c-accent)}
.gn-acts{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:34px}
.gn-ring{position:absolute;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--on-primary) 9%,transparent);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none}
.gn-ph{position:relative;min-height:220px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 22%,transparent);background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,transparent 0 16px,color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 7%,transparent) 16px 17px);overflow:hidden}
.gn-ph::after{content:attr(data-l);position:absolute;left:14px;bottom:12px;right:14px;font:600 11px/1.4 var(--f-head);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.7}
@supports(animation-timeline:view()){.gn-rv{animation:gn-rv linear both;animation-timeline:view();animation-range:entry 0% entry 45%}@keyframes gn-rv{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(34px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}}

/* header */
.gn-hd{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c-primary) 94%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);color:var(--on-primary);border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--on-primary) 10%,transparent)}
.gn-hd .gn-w{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px;min-height:72px}
.gn-logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--on-primary);flex:none}
.gn-logo svg{width:38px;height:37px;display:block}
.gn-wm{font:500 15px/1 var(--f-head);letter-spacing:.34em;text-transform:uppercase}
.gn-wm b{font-weight:500;color:var(--c-accent)}
.gn-nav{display:flex;gap:4px;list-style:none;margin-left:auto}
.gn-nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:999px;font:500 14px var(--f-body);text-decoration:none;color:inherit;opacity:.82;transition:opacity .2s,background .2s}
.gn-nav a:hover{opacity:1;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--on-primary) 10%,transparent)}
.gn-lang{display:flex;gap:2px;font:600 12px var(--f-head);letter-spacing:.1em}
.gn-lang a{min-height:44px;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 8px;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;opacity:.5}
.gn-lang a:first-child{opacity:1;color:var(--c-accent)}
.gn-hd .gn-b{min-height:44px;padding:0 22px;font-size:13px}
.gn-mm{display:none;margin-left:auto}
.gn-mm summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;min-height:44px;display:flex;align-items:center;font:700 12px var(--f-head);letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase}
.gn-mm summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.gn-mm nav{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:100%;background:var(--c-primary);padding:8px clamp(20px,4vw,48px) 22px;display:grid;border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--on-primary) 14%,transparent)}
.gn-mm nav a{min-height:48px;display:flex;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--on-primary) 10%,transparent);text-decoration:none;font:600 20px var(--f-head);color:inherit}
.gn-mm nav .gn-b{margin-top:18px;justify-content:center;font-size:14px}
@media(max-width:960px){.gn-nav,.gn-lang,.gn-hd>.gn-w>.gn-b{display:none}.gn-mm{display:block}}
@media(max-width:420px){.gn-wm{font-size:12px}}

/* home hero */
.gn-hero{min-height:min(92svh,860px);display:flex;align-items:center;padding:clamp(56px,9vw,120px) 0}
.gn-hero .gn-w{position:relative;z-index:2;width:100%}
.gn-hero h1{max-width:9em;font-size:clamp(38px,5.8vw,88px)}
.gn-art{position:absolute;right:-1%;top:50%;width:min(46vw,620px);aspect-ratio:225/220;transform:translateY(-50%);color:var(--on-primary);z-index:1;opacity:.95}
.gn-art svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;overflow:visible}
.gn-art .gn-arrow{animation:gn-up 1.4s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both .3s}
@keyframes gn-up{from{transform:translate(-26px,26px);opacity:0}to{transform:none;opacity:1}}
.gn-hero .gn-ring.a{width:min(88vw,1100px);aspect-ratio:1;right:calc(min(88vw,1100px)*-.3);top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%)}
.gn-hero .gn-ring.b{width:min(118vw,1500px);aspect-ratio:1;right:calc(min(118vw,1500px)*-.34);top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%)}
.gn-cue{position:absolute;left:clamp(20px,4vw,48px);bottom:28px;z-index:2;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font:600 11px var(--f-head);letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.7}
.gn-cue i{font-style:normal;color:var(--c-accent);animation:gn-bob 1.8s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes gn-bob{50%{transform:translate(3px,-5px)}}
@media(max-width:800px){.gn-art{width:92vw;right:-34vw;top:18%;opacity:.28}.gn-hero{min-height:0;align-items:flex-start}.gn-cue{display:none}}

/* marquee */
.gn-mq{background:var(--c-primary);color:var(--on-primary);border-top:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--on-primary) 12%,transparent);border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--on-primary) 12%,transparent);overflow:hidden;padding:20px 0}
.gn-mq div{display:flex;gap:44px;width:max-content;animation:gn-mq 36s linear infinite;font:600 13px var(--f-head);letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}
.gn-mq span{opacity:.7}.gn-mq b{color:var(--c-accent);font-weight:600}
@keyframes gn-mq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.gn-mq div{animation:none}}

/* services bento */
.gn-hd2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px 56px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:clamp(36px,5vw,64px)}
.gn-hd2 p{opacity:.8;max-width:46ch;justify-self:end}
.gn-bento{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:auto auto;gap:20px}
.gn-card{position:relative;border:1px solid var(--c-border);border-radius:28px;padding:clamp(24px,3vw,42px);background:var(--c-surface);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;overflow:hidden;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;transition:border-color .25s,transform .25s}
.gn-card:hover{border-color:var(--c-accent);transform:translateY(-4px)}
.gn-card .no{display:grid;place-items:center;width:46px;height:46px;border:2px solid var(--c-accent);border-radius:50%;font:700 13px var(--f-head);color:var(--c-secondary)}
.gn-card h3{font:var(--hw) clamp(24px,2.6vw,36px)/1.1 var(--f-head);letter-spacing:var(--hls);color:var(--c-primary)}
.gn-card p{opacity:.8;max-width:44ch}
.gn-card ul{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:8px;margin-top:6px;font-size:15px}
.gn-card li::before{content:"↗";color:var(--c-secondary);margin-right:10px;font-weight:700}
.gn-card .go{margin-top:auto;font:700 13px var(--f-head);letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--c-secondary)}
.gn-card.big{grid-row:span 2;background:var(--c-primary);color:var(--on-primary);border-color:var(--c-primary)}
.gn-card.big h3{color:var(--on-primary);font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,52px)}
.gn-card.big .no{color:var(--c-accent)}.gn-card.big .go{color:var(--c-accent)}.gn-card.big li::before{color:var(--c-accent)}
.gn-card.big::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-90px;bottom:-90px;width:300px;aspect-ratio:1;border:30px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--on-primary) 9%,transparent);border-radius:50%;border-top-color:transparent}
@media(max-width:860px){.gn-hd2{grid-template-columns:1fr}.gn-hd2 p{justify-self:start}.gn-bento{grid-template-columns:1fr}.gn-card.big{grid-row:auto}}

/* work grid (dark) */
.gn-wk{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);gap:20px}
.gn-wk a{display:grid;gap:14px;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;grid-column:span 4}
.gn-wk a:first-child{grid-column:span 7;grid-row:span 2}
.gn-wk a:nth-child(2){grid-column:span 5}.gn-wk a:nth-child(3){grid-column:span 5}
.gn-wk .gn-ph{min-height:260px;border-radius:18px;transition:border-color .25s}
.gn-wk a:first-child .gn-ph{min-height:560px}
.gn-wk a:hover .gn-ph{border-color:var(--c-accent)}
.gn-wk h3{font:var(--hw) 22px var(--f-head);color:var(--on-primary);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}
.gn-wk h3 i{font-style:normal;color:var(--c-accent);transition:transform .25s}
.gn-wk a:hover h3 i{transform:translate(4px,-4px)}
.gn-tag{font:600 11px var(--f-head);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.65}
@media(max-width:800px){.gn-wk a,.gn-wk a:first-child,.gn-wk a:nth-child(2),.gn-wk a:nth-child(3){grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:auto}.gn-wk a:first-child .gn-ph{min-height:300px}}

/* steps on an orbit line */
.gn-steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:28px;position:relative;margin-top:clamp(40px,6vw,72px)}
.gn-steps::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:34px;top:35px;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--c-accent),color-mix(in srgb,var(--c-accent) 20%,transparent))}
.gn-steps::after{content:"↗";position:absolute;right:0;top:12px;font:700 28px var(--f-head);color:var(--c-accent)}
.gn-steps li{list-style:none;position:relative;display:grid;gap:12px;align-content:start}
.gn-steps .n{display:grid;place-items:center;width:70px;height:70px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c-surface);border:2px solid var(--c-accent);font:700 18px var(--f-head);color:var(--c-primary);position:relative;z-index:1}
.gn-t .gn-steps .n{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c-primary) 5%,var(--c-surface))}
.gn-steps h3{font:var(--hw) 22px/1.2 var(--f-head);letter-spacing:var(--hls);color:var(--c-primary)}
.gn-steps p{opacity:.8;font-size:15px}
.gn-steps small{font:600 11px var(--f-head);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c-secondary)}
.gn-steps .bring{font-size:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--c-border);padding-top:10px;opacity:.9}
@media(max-width:860px){.gn-steps{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.gn-steps::before,.gn-steps::after{display:none}}
@media(max-width:520px){.gn-steps{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* why (dark, narrow-left wide-right) */
.gn-why{display:grid;grid-template-columns:5fr 7fr;gap:clamp(32px,6vw,96px);align-items:start}
.gn-why ol{list-style:none;border-top:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--on-primary) 22%,transparent)}
.gn-why li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:70px 1fr;gap:6px 18px;padding:26px 0;border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--on-primary) 22%,transparent)}
.gn-why li b{font:700 14px var(--f-head);color:var(--c-accent);grid-row:span 2;padding-top:6px}
.gn-why li h3{font:var(--hw) 26px/1.15 var(--f-head);letter-spacing:var(--hls)}
.gn-why li p{opacity:.78}
@media(max-width:860px){.gn-why{grid-template-columns:1fr}.gn-why li{grid-template-columns:44px 1fr}}

/* blog + learning duo */
.gn-duo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr;gap:clamp(28px,5vw,72px)}
.gn-list{list-style:none;border-top:2px solid var(--c-primary)}
.gn-list a{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:4px 18px;padding:20px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--c-border);text-decoration:none;color:inherit}
.gn-list a:hover h3{color:var(--c-secondary)}
.gn-list h3{font:var(--hw) 21px/1.25 var(--f-head);letter-spacing:var(--hls);color:var(--c-primary)}
.gn-list small{font:600 11px var(--f-head);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c-secondary)}
.gn-list em{font:600 12px var(--f-head);font-style:normal;opacity:.6;align-self:end}
.gn-mini{display:grid;gap:14px}
.gn-mini a{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:20px 24px;border:1px solid var(--c-border);border-radius:999px;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;transition:background .25s,color .25s,border-color .25s}
.gn-mini a:hover{background:var(--c-primary);color:var(--on-primary);border-color:var(--c-primary)}
.gn-mini b{font:700 17px var(--f-head);display:block}.gn-mini span{font-size:13px;opacity:.7}
.gn-mini i{font-style:normal;color:var(--c-secondary);font-size:22px}.gn-mini a:hover i{color:var(--c-accent)}
@media(max-width:860px){.gn-duo{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* faq */
.gn-fq{display:grid;grid-template-columns:5fr 7fr;gap:clamp(28px,6vw,96px);align-items:start}
.gn-fq details{border-top:1px solid var(--c-border);padding:0}
.gn-fq details:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--c-border)}
.gn-fq summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;min-height:64px;padding:12px 0;font:600 18px/1.3 var(--f-head);color:var(--c-primary)}
.gn-fq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.gn-fq summary::after{content:"+";flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;width:36px;height:36px;border:2px solid var(--c-accent);border-radius:50%;font:700 18px var(--f-head);transition:transform .25s,background .25s}
.gn-fq details[open] summary::after{transform:rotate(45deg);background:var(--c-accent)}
.gn-fq details p{padding:0 52px 22px 0;opacity:.82}
@media(max-width:860px){.gn-fq{grid-template-columns:1fr}.gn-fq details p{padding-right:0}}

/* footer CTA */
.gn-ft{background:var(--c-primary);color:var(--on-primary);position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:clamp(72px,10vw,140px) 0 28px}
.gn-ft .gn-ring{width:min(70vw,820px);aspect-ratio:1;right:-14vw;top:-8vw;border-width:2px}
.gn-ft .gn-big{position:relative;z-index:2;display:block;font:var(--hw) clamp(36px,8vw,120px)/1 var(--f-head);letter-spacing:var(--hls);color:var(--on-primary)}
.gn-ft .gn-big em{font-style:normal;color:var(--c-accent)}
.gn-ft .gn-wa{position:relative;z-index:2;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;margin-top:34px;font:700 clamp(22px,3.6vw,48px)/1.1 var(--f-head);color:var(--on-primary);text-decoration:none;border-bottom:3px solid var(--c-accent);padding-bottom:6px;transition:color .25s}
.gn-ft .gn-wa:hover{color:var(--c-accent)}
.gn-ft .gn-wa i{font-style:normal;color:var(--c-accent)}
.gn-ft .gn-mail{position:relative;z-index:2;display:block;margin-top:18px;opacity:.75;font-size:18px}
.gn-cols{position:relative;z-index:2;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:28px;margin-top:clamp(56px,8vw,110px);padding-top:30px;border-top:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--on-primary) 18%,transparent)}
.gn-cols h4{font:600 11px var(--f-head);letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c-accent);margin-bottom:14px}
.gn-cols ul{list-style:none}.gn-cols li a{display:inline-block;min-height:34px;padding:6px 0;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;opacity:.82;font-size:15px}.gn-cols li a:hover{opacity:1;color:var(--c-accent)}
.gn-cols p{opacity:.72;font-size:15px;max-width:36ch;margin-top:16px}
.gn-copy{position:relative;z-index:2;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:34px;font-size:13px;opacity:.65}
.gn-copy a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;margin-left:6px}
@media(max-width:800px){.gn-cols{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.gn-cols>:first-child{grid-column:1/-1}}

/* sub-page hero */
.gn-pg{padding:clamp(56px,8vw,110px) 0 clamp(48px,6vw,84px);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.gn-pg .gn-ring{width:min(46vw,560px);aspect-ratio:1;right:-9vw;top:-8vw;border-width:2px}
.gn-pg .gn-w{position:relative;z-index:2}
.gn-pg h1{max-width:12em}
.gn-chips{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:34px}
.gn-chips a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:0 20px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 35%,transparent);border-radius:999px;font:600 13px var(--f-head);letter-spacing:.06em;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;transition:background .2s,color .2s,border-color .2s}
.gn-chips a:hover,.gn-chips a.on{background:var(--c-accent);border-color:var(--c-accent);color:var(--c-primary)}

/* services blocks */
.gn-sv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:5fr 7fr;gap:clamp(28px,6vw,96px);align-items:start}
.gn-sv.rv>:first-child{order:2}
.gn-sv .big{font:700 clamp(80px,12vw,180px)/.85 var(--f-head);letter-spacing:-.05em;color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:2px var(--c-accent);margin-bottom:18px}
.gn-sv .for{display:inline-block;margin-top:20px;padding:10px 18px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 30%,transparent);border-radius:999px;font-size:14px}
.gn-inc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(20px,3vw,40px)}
.gn-inc h4{font:600 11px var(--f-head);letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--c-accent);margin-bottom:6px;color:var(--c-secondary)}
.gn-d .gn-inc h4{color:var(--c-accent)}
.gn-inc div:last-child h4{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 35%,transparent);color:inherit;opacity:.7}
.gn-inc li{list-style:none;padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 14%,transparent);font-size:15px;line-height:1.5}
.gn-inc div:first-child li::before{content:"↗ ";color:var(--c-secondary);font-weight:700}
.gn-d .gn-inc div:first-child li::before{color:var(--c-accent)}
.gn-inc div:last-child li{opacity:.7}
@media(max-width:860px){.gn-sv{grid-template-columns:1fr}.gn-sv.rv>:first-child{order:0}.gn-inc{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.gn-more{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:clamp(32px,4vw,56px)}
.gn-more>div{border:1px solid var(--c-border);border-radius:28px;padding:30px;display:grid;gap:10px;align-content:start}
.gn-more b{font:700 13px var(--f-head);color:var(--c-secondary);letter-spacing:.2em}
.gn-more h3{font:var(--hw) 26px var(--f-head);color:var(--c-primary)}.gn-more p{opacity:.8}
@media(max-width:800px){.gn-more{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* case page */
.gn-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);border-top:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--on-primary) 22%,transparent);margin-top:clamp(36px,5vw,64px)}
.gn-meta div{padding:18px 18px 0 0}.gn-meta small{display:block;font:600 11px var(--f-head);letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c-accent);margin-bottom:6px}
.gn-meta a{color:inherit}
@media(max-width:700px){.gn-meta{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.gn-3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:clamp(20px,3vw,48px)}
.gn-3>div{border-top:2px solid var(--c-accent);padding-top:18px}
.gn-3 h3{font:600 11px var(--f-head);letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c-secondary);margin-bottom:12px}
.gn-3 p{font-size:18px;line-height:1.6}
@media(max-width:800px){.gn-3{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

The questions I get most often.

Still unsure about something? Ask directly. An answer costs nothing.

What do I need to prepare before we start?

Your business details, a sense of who your customers are, and any logos or photos you already have. I will tell you exactly what else is needed after the discovery call.

Do you do the design and the SEO, or just the build?

Both. The site is built with on-page SEO and analytics in place before launch, so you are not paying twice to fix it later.

Can I edit the site myself afterwards?

Yes. It is a clean Elementor build, and I walk you through it at handover.

How long does a company site take?

Typically 3 to 4 weeks from start to launch, depending on how quickly content comes in.

How many rounds of changes are included?

Two rounds of revisions, so the project does not turn into an endless loop.

Do you only work with businesses in Johor Bahru?

I am based in Johor Bahru and work with businesses across Malaysia.

pages.html:
Learning

I write down what I learn. Here it lives.

Three free study sites, built and kept up to date by me. Use them in any order you like.

01 / EN

English

English notes for complete beginners who read Chinese. Grammar, vocabulary, speaking, listening, reading and writing, sorted by level.

  • 6 skills: grammar, vocabulary, speaking, listening, reading, writing
  • 4 levels: A1–A2, B1–B2, C1, C2
  • Written for zero-basis Chinese speakers
Open english.grownotic.com ↗
370 notes（2026-10-06 数据，会变）[上线前核对]
02 / JP

Japanese

Japanese from zero, following the JLPT path from N5 up to N1, plus topic pages for the parts people get stuck on.

  • JLPT N5 to N1, in a 7-stop learning path
  • Topic pages: keigo, particles, kanji, listening
  • Readable layout: large text, terms explained on first use
Open japanese.grownotic.com ↗
126 notes（2026-10-06 数据，会变）[上线前核对]
03 / WP

WP Lab

WordPress, two ways: a course to follow in order, and a toolbox to look things up in. Plus fixes for the problems people actually hit.

  • Learn: a theme-development course, read in order
  • Toolbox: notes grouped by tool, for looking things up
  • Fix: a situation-to-notes guide, for when something is broken
  • Build: a checklist from zero to launch
Open wplab.grownotic.com ↗
185 + 171 notes（2026-10-05 数据，会变）[上线前核对]
